purpose: Test whether retaining the Qwen GDN custom op inside the torch-compiled graph removes material per-layer dispatch gaps at TP2 c64 without corrupting persistent recurrent state.

protected_control.relationship: immutable promoted comparison; R25 cannot replace it without a separately preregistered two-fresh-server confirmation and complete c1-c64 ladder

evidence_basis.r24_boundary: R24 did not load weights or test compilation. PIECEWISE mode rejected a partial attention split list in CudagraphDispatcher; the devices remained healthy.
evidence_basis.why_none_is_valid_for_c64: The protected server captured only size 1. The measured c64 batches were outside that graph, so disabling cudagraphs changes c1 behavior but does not remove an active c64 graph.

single_variable_at_measured_shape.control: torch.compile with GDN split out of compiled regions; no size-64 graph exists
single_variable_at_measured_shape.candidate: torch.compile with the three Qwen/XPU GDN core ops omitted from splitting_ops; cudagraph mode NONE
single_variable_at_measured_shape.unchanged: image, source, kernel, model, TP2 server limits, c64 graph status, direct P2P policy, requests, oracle, and qualifier
single_variable_at_measured_shape.out_of_scope: c1 is expected to lose its size-1 graph and cannot be inferred from this c64 screen

measurement.excluded_warmup: one identical c64 group after health and before measurement; it exercises recurrent-state reuse before the measured group
measurement.required_activation_gate: effective config is cudagraph-NONE, retains non-GDN split points, omits all three Qwen/XPU GDN split ops, both ranks activate direct P2P, and the official block-scaled FP8 kernel is selected
measurement.required_output_gate: 64 complete 128-token responses, zero cached prompt tokens, complete raw token IDs, and no cross-base frozen-oracle collision
measurement.required_cleanup: container removed, no non-wrapper model process, and benchmark port closed

decision.promising_definition: at least 5% above the protected 774.394144 c64 median with every activation, output, recurrent-state reuse, and cleanup gate passed
decision.if_promising: preregister a fresh confirmation and investigate a source-level hybrid that restores the c1 graph while keeping GDN compiled at c64; do not publish R25 directly
decision.if_below_promising: preserve as a negative or neutral diagnostic; do not promote or alter the protected result
